creator: Alexander Terp
description: Found 2026-11-05 while fixing Codex delivery: the live message cases' shared helper runs with no pane or inbox, so a post without --as is from the human, and automatic groups are named by callsigns, yet older idle/sandboxed Codex and OpenCode cases still expect an implicit named integrator and an 'integrator+worker' pair. The Codex cases touched by 276936d9 were fixed; check the rest under ./dev --codex and ./dev --opencode.
title: Older live message checks assume a named integrator and a literal integrator+worker group
